newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia stocks open cautiously mixed.
newsitem.headline: Australia stocks open cautiously mixed.

text.p: Australian shares opened narrowly mixed on Monday with investors cautious ahead of an important Reserve Bank of Australia board meeting on Tuesday and after offshore markets lent few leads on Friday.

At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT), the All Ordinaries index was down 0.1 point at 2,339.3. Turnover was light at the opening and most blue chip issues started the session a few cents higher or lower compared to their close on Friday.
"This market should be very quiet until the results of the RBA board meeting and the U.S. election are known," a dealer from a Sydney-based brokerage said.
The dealer said the Melbourne Cup holiday in Victoria on Tuesday was another factor that would sideline investors on Monday and Tuesday.

"Although the market is still unsure whether the RBA will move to cut rates on Wednesday the futures market has opened a bit stronger, suggesting some players are reasonably confident of a cut," the dealer said.
